sql: SELECT p.PromotionCategory AS PromotionCategory, SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS DiscountedOnlineRevenue, AVG(p.DiscountPercent) AS AvgDiscountPercent FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey WHERE f.DiscountAmount > 0 GROUP BY p.PromotionCategory ORDER BY DiscountedOnlineRevenue DESC
